name: Avalon Resort & Campground
note: Clothing-optional resort on a mountainside at 223 Avalon Rd near Paw Paw in the Eastern Panhandle (AANR-affiliated; annual membership optional - visitors pay day fees); 127 sites in three campground areas around the lodge, pool and hall: open tent camping, primitive/pop-up sites, water/electric and full-hookup RV sites, premium RV sites, log cabins; two bathhouses with laundry. RV site fees per night, double occupancy: W/E $30, W/E/S $35, premium $65 - PLUS the resort day fee every guest pays for each day or partial day: $30 single / $50 couple ($25/$40 AANR, half price Thursdays, first visit $10/$20), so two adults pay about $80 a night in all. Google 4.6 over 176 reviews; RV Life 5* on 1 review. --Claude
inclusion_evidence: avalon-resort.com/lodging and /day-fees (read 2026-09-30): RV Site W-E $30/day double occupancy, W-E-S $35, premium $65, plus mandatory day fees $30/$50 single/couple (first visit $10/$20); anyone may visit without membership -> real transient RV campground at a clothing-optional resort. Site fee $30 <= $50, but site + couple day fee is ~$80; added at AWH's direction 2026-09-30 ('Keep Avalon, but mention clothing-optional in the note'). Quality: Google Maps 4.6 over 176 reviews
